captions.detailed: A classic upright arcade cabinet featuring a dark boxy lower base and a tall upper display section with an angled control deck. The control panel is populated with two joystick controllers (red spherical tops on thin metal shafts) and a horizontal row of colorful push buttons (blue, green, yellow, and red). A rectangular cashbox door is mounted on the front face of the lower cabinet, designed to swing open on a side hinge, while the control buttons can be pressed down vertically.
captions.instruction: Design a 3D model of a classic two-player arcade machine cabinet. It should feature a tall, boxy lower cabinet base, an upper screen section, a wide protruding control deck with two joysticks and four colorful circular buttons (blue, green, yellow, red), and a hinged cashbox door on the lower front. Ensure the cashbox door has a revolute hinge joint and each button is configured as a prismatic push control.
captions.factory: The model is built using a custom articulated object framework. The cabinet base and upper display housing are constructed using box primitives, with an angled control deck wedge created by intersecting box shapes. The joysticks are modeled with cylinder shafts and sphere tops. Individual colorful start buttons are created from cylinder primitives and linked to the deck via prismatic joints. The cashbox door is a thin box primitive attached to the lower front face of the cabinet via a revolute joint on its side edge.
